messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Billing alert: anomalous token counts detected. Metric meter.stream_vs_batch delta large. Event id 1768001234
oncall-sre: ACK. Paging in. What are we seeing?
oncall-ml: stream shows ~1.6M tokens/hr for recent window; batch aggregate shows ~150k. Either huge backlog or double-counts.
maria: support: weve had a handful of customers report overage notices in the last 20-30m. Acme-Corp opened a ticket.
devon: running quick queries against streaming and batch.
devon: query: SELECT hour, SUM(tokens) FROM meter.streaming_tokens WHERE hour >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour DESC
devon: spike between 15:00-16:00 UTC: streaming 1,620,431 vs batch 148,223 for same hour.
oncall-sre: can you check kafka consumer offsets: kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group meter-aggregator ?
devon: consumer lag ~3M msgs on metering.events.v1 around 15:05 UTC. Looks like aggregator fell behind.
billing-systems: saw consumer restart at 15:03 UTC due to deploy 2026.02.11; auto-rollback happened but aggregator didn't fully catch up.
jen: finance-ops: weve already sent some automated overage emails. Please pause billing notifications until we know real numbers.
oncall-ml: propose immediate actions: 1) Pause billing notifications 2) Pause invoice generation 3) Reprocess backlog with dedupe heuristics 4) Enable streaming-based fallback aggregator (best-effort)
alex: agree to pause outbound billing messages and mute enforcement quotas to prevent false throttles.
oncall-sre: toggling feature flag now. @billing-systems, flip billing.notifications off.
billing-systems: billing.notifications -> OFF. Logged.
incident-bot: feature-flag change recorded: billing.notifications=false by billing-systems @1768001320
maria: informed Acme-Corp and opened internal support note. They asked for ETA. Told them ~1h for initial fix.
devon: investigating producers. Running replay with tools/replay-kafka to reprocess from safe offset and sample diff.
devon: sample replay command: ./tools/replay-kafka --topic metering.events.v1 --from-offset 1500000 --to-latest --consumer-group meter-aggregator-replay --parallel 8
devon: found tokenizer change merged at 14:58 UTC (PR #432). Could that change token counts?
oncall-ml: check tokenizer determinism. If streaming used a newer tokenizer that batch reprocess doesn't, counts will differ. Any tokenizer releases?
jen: yes, tokenizer/main had a merge at ~14:58. Timing matches.
devon: reprocess sample (100k events) results: streaming_tokens 1,620,431; canonical reprocessed 1,589,219; delta ~31k (2%). Not enough to explain 10x.
oncall-sre: anything about duplicates?
devon: ingest-producer logs show repeated flush timeout errors at 15:02 leading to retries. Producer retries created events with new UUIDs, bypassing consumer dedupe.
billing-systems: our dedupe depends on event_id dedupe; new retries with new IDs slip through. Need producer-side idempotency tokens.
oncall-ml: short-term: reprocess with payload-hash dedupe plus canonical tokenizer. Longer-term: enforce idempotency token header and stricter producer backoff.
jen: finance-ops: provide list of customers who got overage emails so we can prepare provisional credits.
maria: support list: Acme-Corp, BrightPlan, EduNext, plus ~12 smaller accounts. Collating now.
devon: started reprocess at 1768001405. ETA ~45m to catch up with parallelism 8.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-INC-9876 created, severity=P2. Notifying oncall-sre, oncall-ml, devon, billing-systems.
oncall-sre: creating a quick dashboard for meter.delta and billing.queue.backlog.
--- DASHBOARD SNIPPET ---
meter.delta: ~1.4M tokens
billing.queue.backlog: ~2.9M msgs
avg.consumer.throughput: ~120k msgs/s
---
oncall-sre: live mitigation plan: 1) Keep billing notifications paused 2) Run dedupe reprocess 3) Mark invoices in pending_review 4) Issue provisional credits for top impacted customers
alex: approve provisional credits for top 3 customers; finance please tag against PD-INC-9876.
finance-ops: provisional credits created and tagged.
maria: updated Acme-Corp with pause + provisional credit promise. They want ETA and follow-up.
devon: reprocess dedupe reduced duplicates by ~92%. Projected post-reprocess delta ~60k tokens/hr, within variance.
devon: reprocess mostly finished at 1768001720. Reconcile running to merge aggregates.
billing-systems: reconcile merged at 1768001735. Post-merge: streaming_total 2,018,123 vs batch_total 1,995,004 delta 23,119 (~1.15%). Within expected SLAs.
jen: should we re-enable notifications? Suggest: enable usage_summary but keep overage/enforcement notifications off; hold invoice run until finance signs off.
oncall-sre: enabling usage_summary notifications, keeping overage notifications disabled.
billing-systems: billing.notifications.usage_summary = ON; billing.notifications.overage = OFF @1768001800
support-bot: templated follow-ups sent to affected customers explaining pause, reprocess, and credits.
maria: created support follow-ups and will attach finance CSV once available.
alex: handing off to night oncall: @oncall-sre-night to monitor and escalate if backlog resurges.
oncall-sre: handoff notes: root cause = producer retry storm + missing producer idempotency; contributing = tokenizer change that increased counts slightly. Mitigations: notifications paused, dedupe reprocess with canonical tokenizer, provisional credits, invoice generation paused.
oncall-sre-night: acknowledged and will monitor per runbook (escalate if backlog >100k for >10m).
incident-bot: PD-INC-9876 state -> mitigated at 1768001880; postmortem owner assigned: devon.
jen: finance to confirm final credits & resume invoice pipeline tomorrow 09:00 UTC after signoff.
finance-ops: will validate credits and confirm by 09:00 UTC next day.
alex: please add timeline, queries, logs, replay commands to postmortem and tag product/support/finance.
devon: creating postmortem doc at /docs/incidents/1768001234-metering-pipeline-drift-postmortem and will link when published.
incident-bot: reminder to attach sevdoc to PD-INC-9876 and close thread after postmortem link posted.
jenn: nice coordination everyone. :thumbsup:
